changes: The card is written for Year 9 in Queensland, South Australia, Western Australia, Tasmania, ACT and Northern Territory; the NSW Stage 5 course needs its own depth and framing for Years 9 and 10 and should refer to NSW Stage 5 outcomes and the HI5-CPP-01 focus on contested issues.
The example in Question b uses Brisbane in Queensland and Labor supporters; it should be localised to a New South Wales setting, such as Sydney or another NSW town, to suit the course.
The card does not cover the NSW-specific local response or the sources and perspectives NSW students are expected to examine, so an NSW example or source should be added.
match.reason: The bank card teaches the same 1916 and 1917 conscription referendums at a suitable depth, but it is written for other states and needs local changes for NSW Stage 5.

confirm.reason: The bank point already teaches the 1916 and 1917 conscription referendums, their defeat and the divisions they caused, at a Years 9–10 depth, and nothing in it is out of place for NSW students.
